_description: Bank no-op A/B input set for Stage 11-D (Run 2). Exists solely to exercise SectionCompanyProfiles' BANK_ROWS path — which manual entry cannot reach (companyType defaults to 'standard' and there are no bank-fact inputs), so isFinancial() is false and STANDARD_ROWS render. A real bank pair is required to prove ptbvMcap is byte-identical to the old shared mcap.

rationale.JPM / BAC: Both are banks → the fetch tags companyType='financial' (and bank SICs), so isFinancial(acquirer) && isFinancial(target) is true and §B renders BANK_ROWS incl. 'Price / tangible book'. This is the ONLY way to route through the ptbvMcap branch; a manual pair renders STANDARD_ROWS and never exercises it.
rationale.offer 60: > BAC's live price (~$47), so tpp > 0 and the deal builds; the offer value is immaterial to the P/TBV proof (§B P/TBV reads currentMarketCap-first via ptbvMcap).
rationale.determinism: Auto mode is live, but /api/price has a 5-minute TTL cache and fundamentals/bank-facts cache longer. Run A (edited) and Run B (un-edited) execute back-to-back within that window (~2.5 min total), so both see identical cached data — making the A/B byte-identical for a no-op edit. This is why the bank run is auto, not the offline manual harness.

result.note: §B P/TBV (trading basis via currentMarketCap) and the Dashboard P/TBV (acquisition basis via calcPTBV → marketCap) disagree by construction — that is D13, expected and logged, not a regression.
